verdict.rationale: Qapita's own docs say it gives founders and investors a real-time, single-source-of-truth view of the cap table. It also offers cap table and compliance reporting for legal teams, which covers the cap-table-sharing part of the story. Nothing in the evidence mentions a data room, document storage or sharing, granular permissions, or diligence workflows. Missing for 10: a documented data room for underlying documents, permission controls for external counsel and investors, diligence-ready packaging, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
